Upgrade plivo to the latest GitHub release.

Fetches the latest release tag, compares it to the running version, then
downloads the matching binary for your OS/arch and atomically replaces the
current binary in place.

If you installed via Homebrew this command will refuse — use `brew upgrade plivo` instead.

Usage:
  plivo upgrade [flags]

Examples:
  plivo upgrade                 # install latest
  plivo upgrade --check         # check only, don't install
  plivo upgrade --version v0.2.0
  plivo upgrade --force         # reinstall even if already on latest

Flags:
      --check            report whether a newer release exists, but don't install
      --force            reinstall even if the running binary is already on the target release
  -h, --help             help for upgrade
      --version string   install a specific release tag instead of latest (e.g. v0.2.0)

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
